message: 備えよ、常に

name: Synn
message: 「Huh... Why are those in front of my place?」
Two luxury cars are parked right in front of Grand Palace Sakura.
Hanging from the rearview mirror of one of them is a tiny Tontoro keychain, showing it belongs to Lolotte's... the Rosenkreuz family.

name: Riesling
message: 「Installation is complete.」

name: Helena
message: 「Great work, as always.」

name: Riesling
message: 「You flatter me.」

name: Helena
message: 「Just in case, tell me how to disarm it.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Please undo the fasteners on the black box in the order of A, B, C, and D. However, turn the screws clockwise rather than counterclockwise.」
Helena-san and Riesling-san stride briskly out of the entrance. The two of them look far too out of place emerging from inside a dilapidated apartment building.
N-No, forget about that--

name: Synn
message: 「Helena-san!」

name: Helena
message: 「Hii, Synn-chan. Welcome home\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, hey, thanks, I'm home」

name: Synn
message: 「...Wait, no, what on earth were you doing at my place?!」

name: Helena
message: 「I got permission from your father, Synn-chan. What I actually did is a secret, though♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Riesling-san!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Leave the Chairwoman's 'what-have-you' to me, Riesling Tooyama.」

name: Synn
message: 「Tell me properly!!」

name: Helena
message: 「'Kid, there are things in this world you're better off not knowing, ya know? Are you sure you wanna start counting sleepless nights just 'cause you peeked?'」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Um, that makes me insanely curious, you know?」

name: Helena
message: 「Jeez, it's just part of our Re-Crea countermeasures. Don't worry, I didn't plant anything to spy on your private life.」

name: Helena
message: 「Well then, we're heading back. Let's race to the school, Tamiko-chan.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Beware the nights when the nue cries...」

name: Riesling
message: 「Now then」

name: Synn
message: 「W-what? What is it!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「I wouldn't mind telling you, Lord Synn?」

name: Synn
message: 「I wanna know! Aah, but I'm so scared to find ouuut」
